defective_pattern: Using bold font for table captions in APA 7 Markdown/DOCX and leaving narrative body paragraphs unjustified in DOCX.
why_defective: APA 7 mandates regular (non-bold) font for table titles/captions. Furthermore, Persian narrative text in DOCX requires explicit full justification tags (<w:jc w:val="both"/>) to render correctly.
observed_symptoms: Table captions are bolded in Markdown or DOCX output.
Narrative paragraphs in DOCX appear left-aligned or right-aligned instead of fully justified.
corrective_remedy: Ensure table captions are regular non-bold font. Ensure all narrative body paragraphs in DOCX explicitly contain <w:jc w:val="both"/>.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Regex matching bold Markdown table captions or DOCX paragraphs missing justification.
